verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a Render capability for exporting all account or service data in open formats to leave the platform. Docker support, the render.yaml Blueprint file, the REST API and CLI, and database recovery features are adjacent building blocks or other features, not a documented data-export path. The migration-credits item concerns moving onto Render, not off it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
